questions.question: (1)/(3) part of groceries sell at a profit of 18%, (1)/(4) part at a profit of 25% and remain sell at a profit of 30%. If the total profit is Rs 1980, find the desired price of groceries.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Profit % = (1/3 × 18%) + (1/4 × 25%) + (5/12 × 30%)

Effective Profit % = 6% + 6.25% + 12.5% = 24.75%

According to question: 24.75% of Total CP = ₹1980

Total CP = (1980 ÷ 24.75) × 100 = 8000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First part = 1/3 at 18% profit | Second part = 1/4 at 25% profit | Total profit = ₹1980

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84c5ead9581a3c94f0d43610923402d78643077d231a17dd40025345165eac03.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Remaining part** = 1 − (1/3 + 1/4) = 1 − 7/12 = 5/12

⇒ Let the **Total Cost Price** be 1200 units (LCM of 3 and 4 multiplied by 100)

⇒ Profit from 1/3 part = 1/3 × 1200 × 18/100 = 400 × 18/100 = 72 units

⇒ Profit from 1/4 part = 1/4 × 1200 × 25/100 = 300 × 25/100 = 75 units

⇒ Profit from 5/12 part = 5/12 × 1200 × 30/100 = 500 × 30/100 = 150 units

⇒ **Total Profit** in units = 72 + 75 + 150 = 297 units

⇒ 297 units = ₹1980

⇒ 1 unit = 1980 ÷ 297 = 20/3

⇒ Total CP = 1200 units = 1200 × 20/3 = 400 × 20 = 8000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Overall Profit Percentage

When different parts of an article are sold at different profit rates, the net profit % = Σ(Partₙ × Profit%ₙ).

Cost Price Formula

If the absolute profit value and profit percentage are known, Cost Price (CP) = (Total Profit × 100) ÷ Net Profit %.

Profit/Loss on Remaining Parts

Remaining part = 1 − (Σ given fractions). Ensure the sum of all fractional parts equals 1 before calculating net effect.

questions.question: Rahna decided to buy a scooty that costs ₹40,000. The shopkeeper agreed to sell the scooty under the condition of ₹25,000 cash down payment of ₹4,000 each month for four months. Find the rate of interest at which the shopkeeper sold the scooty under the instalment scheme.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cash price = 40000

Cash down payment = 25000

Amount paid in monthly installment = 4000 × 4 = 16000

**Calculations:**

Interest charged = (25000 + 16000) – 40000 = 1000 rupees

Now, principal for first month = 40000 – 25000 = 15000

Principal for second month = 15000 – 4000 = 11000

Principal for third month = 11000 – 4000 = 7000

Principal for fourth month = 7000 – 4000 = 3000

Total principal = 15000 + 11000 + 7000 + 3000 = 36000 rupees

∴ Rate of interest on 36000 rupees = 1000 × 12 × (100 / 36000) = 100/3 = 33.33%

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: An electric pole was broken at a certain height, and it made an angle of 60° with the ground at 160 m apart. Find the original height of the pole.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a 30°−60°−90° triangle, the sides (Base : Height : Hypotenuse) are in the ratio 1 : √3 : 2.

Base (adjacent to 60°) = 1 unit = 160 m.

Standing height of the pole = √3 units = 160√3 m.

Broken part of the pole (Hypotenuse) = 2 units = 2 × 160 = 320 m.

Total height = Standing part + Broken part = 160√3 + 320 = 160(√3 + 2) m.

**∴ The correct answer is 160(√3 + 2) m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Distance of the tip of the broken pole from the base = 160 m, Angle with the ground = 60°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f00963aeda9075cd28dc4747a03c83a70ec122c7cd7787e9acf739c787d8e54a.png] 

Let the standing height of the pole be h and the length of the broken part be l.

⇒ In the right-angled triangle formed:

⇒ tan 60° = Perpendicular / Base = h / 160

⇒ √3 = h / 160 ⇒ h = 160√3 m

⇒ cos 60° = Base / Hypotenuse = 160 / l

⇒ 1 / 2 = 160 / l ⇒ l = 160 × 2 = 320 m

⇒ Original height of the pole = Standing part (h) + Broken part (l)

⇒ Original height = 160√3 + 320 = 160(√3 + 2) m

**∴ The correct answer is 160(√3 + 2) m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Height and Distance Fundamentals

In problems involving broken objects, the total height is always the sum of the vertical part (perpendicular) and the slanted broken part (hypotenuse).

Trigonometric Identities

Common values used: tan 30° = 1/√3, tan 45° = 1, tan 60° = √3. Also, sec θ = 1/cos θ can be used directly for the hypotenuse.

30-60-90 Triangle Rule

In any 30°−60°−90° triangle, the side opposite to 30° is x, the side opposite to 60° is x√3, and the hypotenuse is 2x.</p

questions.question: 18 men can complete (1)/(5) of a work in 10 days. How many people are required to complete (2)/(5) of the same work in 5 days?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the MDH formula: (M₁ × D₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × D₂) / W₂

Given: (18 × 10) / (1/5) = (M₂ × 5) / (2/5)

⇒ 180 × 5 = M₂ × 5 × (5/2)

⇒ 180 = M₂ × (5/2)

⇒ M₂ = (180 × 2) / 5 = 72

**∴ The correct option is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial men (M₁) = 18

Initial days (D₁) = 10

Initial work (W₁) = 1/5

New days (D₂) = 5

New work (W₂) = 2/5

**Formula Used:**

(M₁ × D₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × D₂) / W₂

 CASE 1 Men (M1) = 18 Days (D1) = 10 Work (W1) = 1/5 CASE 2 Men (M2) = ? Days (D2) = 5 Work (W2) = 2/5 
• M1 × D1 / W1 = M2 × D2 / W2 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (18 × 10) / (1/5) = (M₂ × 5) / (2/5)

⇒ 180 × 5 = (M₂ × 5 × 5) / 2

⇒ 900 = (25 × M₂) / 2

⇒ 1800 = 25 × M₂

⇒ M₂ = 1800 / 25

⇒ M₂ = 72

**∴ The correct option is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

MDH Rule / Chain Rule

The general formula is (M₁ × D₁ × H₁ × E₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂ × E₂) / W₂, where M is men, D is days, H is hours, E is efficiency, and W is work.

Inverse Proportion

For a constant amount of work, the number of men is inversely proportional to the number of days taken: M₁D₁ = M₂D₂.

Work and Efficiency

Total work is the product of the number of workers, the time they work, and their individual efficiency: W = M × D × H × E.

questions.question: A person's age after 15 years will be four times his age 15 years back. What is his present age (in years)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total time interval = **15 years ago** to **15 years later** = 15 + 15 = 30 years.

Ratio of **Past Age** : **Future Age** = 1 : 4.

Difference in ratio parts = 4 − 1 = 3 units.

3 units = 30 years ⇒ 1 unit = 10 years.

Present age = Past age + 15 = 10 + 15 = 25 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 25 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let the **present age** of the person be x years.

Age 15 years ago = (x − 15) years.

Age 15 years later = (x + 15) years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d8c0fc4a1e7edee944fff28594d31e0444142fd49ffe59d7f12386a3effeb8a.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Future Age = n × Past Age

**Calculations:**

⇒ x + 15 = 4 × (x − 15)

⇒ x + 15 = 4x − 60

⇒ 4x − x = 60 + 15

⇒ 3x = 75

⇒ x = 75 ÷ 3

⇒ x = 25 years

**∴ The correct answer is 25 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

General Age Relation

If a person's **present age** is x, then the age after 'n' years is (x + n) and the age 'm' years ago was (x − m).

Ratio and Proportions in Ages

The **age difference** between two individuals always remains **constant**, regardless of the number of years that pass.

Linear Equations for Ages

Most age problems can be solved by translating the word statement into a **linear equation** in one variable (usually the present age).</p

questions.question: If a² + b² + c² = ab + bc + ac, then the value of (a+c)/(b) is
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Whenever **a² + b² + c² = ab + bc + ac**, the condition **a = b = c** must be satisfied.

To find the value of (a + c) / b, assume a = b = c = 1.

Substitute the values: (1 + 1) / 1 = 2 / 1 = 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** a² + b² + c² = ab + bc + ac

**Formula Used:** (x − y)² = x² + y² − 2xy

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc793cf74328a1228be51754052ab4e0356e9e695180ea35ab831b6901c1f728.png] 

⇒ a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ac = 0

Multiply the entire equation by 2:

⇒ 2a² + 2b² + 2c² − 2ab − 2bc − 2ac = 0

⇒ (a² − 2ab + b²) + (b² − 2bc + c²) + (c² − 2ac + a²) = 0

⇒ (a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)² = 0

Since the sum of squares of real numbers is zero, each term must be zero:

⇒ a − b = 0, b − c = 0, and c − a = 0

⇒ **a = b = c**

Now, calculate the expression:

⇒ (a + c) / b = (b + b) / b

⇒ 2b / b = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Special Algebraic Identity

The expression a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca). If a² + b² + c² = ab + bc + ca, then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc.

Sum of Squares Property

For any real numbers x, y, and z, if x² + y² + z² = 0, then it implies x = 0, y = 0, and z = 0 simultaneously.

Conditional Equality

If a + b + c = 0, then the identity also simplifies to a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc, which is frequently used in **competitive exams**.</p

questions.question: If x² - 6x - 1 = 0, then find the value of x²+(1)/(x²)-8.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x²-6x-1=0, find x²+(1)/(x²)-8

Calculations:

x²-6x-1=0 ⇒ x²-6x-1= -6x

Divide by x: x-(1)/(x)=6

Identity: (x-(1)/(x))²=x²+(1)/(x²)-2

⇒ x-(1)/(x)=6

⇒ (x-(1)/(x))²=6²=36

⇒ x²+(1)/(x²)-2=36

⇒ x²+(1)/(x²)=38

⇒ x²+(1)/(x²)-8=30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

questions.question: During a festival season, an electric gadget marked at ₹ 5,000 is offered on sale at ₹ 4,250 after giving a certain discount. If discount percentage is reduced by 5%, at what price the electric gadget will be available to customers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

According to the question, the discount percentage is reduced by 5%

So, The increase in selling price = 5% of the market price.

The final selling price = 4250 + [5000 × (5/100)] = 4250 + 250 = ₹ 4500

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Market price = ₹ 5000

Selling price = ₹ 4250

Discount reduced = 5%

**Formula used:**

Discount = M.P. - S.P.

Discount% = (Discount/M.P.) × 100

Where, M.P. = Market price

S.P. = Selling price

**Calculation:**

The initial discount = 5000 - 4250 = ₹ 750

The discount percentage = (750/5000) × 100 = 15%

The final discount = (15 - 5)% = 10%

The final selling price = (100 - 10)/100 × 5000 = ₹ 4500

**∴ The electric gadget will be available to customers at ₹ 4500**

questions.question: A sells an article to B making a profit of (1)/(5) of his outlay. B sells it to C, gaining 20%. If C sells it for Rs 600 and incurs a loss of (1)/(6) of his outlay, the cost price of A is -
questions.solution:
Given:

A sells an article to B making a profit of 1/5 of his outlay 

B sells it to C gaining 20% 

C sells it for Rs. 600 and incurs a loss of 1/6 of his outlay

Concept used:

S.P = C.P × (100 + P%)/100 

S.P = C.P × (100 – L%)/100

Where,

S.P → Selling price 

C.P → Cost price 

P% → Profit% 

L% → Loss%

Calculations:

Let C.P of the product for A be 100x 

Profit gained by A = 100x × 1/5 = 20x 

S.P of the product for A = 100x + 20x = 120x 

C.P of the product for B = S.P of the product for A 

C.P of the product for B = 120x 

S.P of the product for B = 120x × (100 + 20)/100 = 144x 

C.P of the product for C = S.P of the product for B 

C.P of the product for C = 144x 

Loss incurred by C = 144x × 1/6 = 24x 

S.P of product for C = 144x – 24x = 120x 

According to the question 

⇒ 120x = 600 

⇒ x = 5 

C.P of the product for A = 100x = 500

∴ C.P of the product for A be Rs. 500

questions.question: If 5 cos θ = 4 sin θ, 0° ≤ θ ≤ 90°, then what will be the value of sec θ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given: 5 cos θ = 4 sin θ ⇒ **tan θ** = 5/4.

For a right-angled triangle, if Perpendicular = 5 and Base = 4, then **Hypotenuse** = √(5² + 4²) = √41.

Since **sec θ** = Hypotenuse / Base, we get sec θ = √41 / 4.

**∴ The correct answer is √41 / 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0aa015c150cc255f3991ed44d6e1c5474980ce175ced67755d9166910f717b6.png] 

**Given:** 5 cos θ = 4 sin θ and 0° ≤ θ ≤ 90°.

**Formula Used:** tan θ = sin θ / cos θ and sec²θ = 1 + tan²θ.

⇒ 5 cos θ = 4 sin θ

⇒ sin θ / cos θ = 5 / 4

⇒ **tan θ = 5 / 4**

⇒ sec²θ = 1 + (5 / 4)²

⇒ sec²θ = 1 + 25 / 16

⇒ sec²θ = (16 + 25) / 16 = 41 / 16

⇒ sec θ = √(41 / 16) = √41 / 4

**∴ The correct answer is √41 / 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Fundamental relations: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Right Triangle Ratios

sec θ is the reciprocal of cos θ. In a right triangle, sec θ = Hypotenuse / Base.

Pythagoras Theorem

In a right-angled triangle, Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base².</p

questions.question: A vegetable seller has a faulty weight of 2 kg which is 100 g less than the actual weight. He sold 2 kg of potatoes to a customer using the same faulty weight for Rs. 44. The cost price of potatoes to the seller was Rs. 18 per kg. How much profit did he earn on selling the potatoes?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **actual weight** delivered: 2 kg − 100 g = **1.9 kg**.

Calculate total **Cost Price (CP)** for the actual weight: 1.9 kg × Rs. 18/kg = **Rs. 34.2**.

Given **Selling Price (SP)** for the transaction = **Rs. 44**.

**Profit** = SP − CP = 44 − 34.2 = **Rs. 9.8**.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 9.8.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Faulty weight = 2 kg (100 g less), **CP** = Rs. 18/kg, **Total SP** = Rs. 44.

**Formulas:** Profit = SP − CP | Total CP = Actual Weight × Rate per kg.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72544b8800525d6e1e513c841026b6af5b5a2cd32ea60c7e04cfb31e80488013.png] 

⇒ **Actual Weight** used by seller = 2000 g − 100 g = **1900 g** or **1.9 kg**.

⇒ **Cost Price (CP)** of 1.9 kg = 1.9 × 18 = **Rs. 34.2**.

⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** of the quantity = **Rs. 44**.

⇒ **Profit** = 44 − 34.2 = **Rs. 9.8**.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 9.8.**

**__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Concept

When a dealer uses **faulty weights**, the profit is calculated on the **actual weight** delivered to the customer, as that represents the seller's true investment.

Profit Percentage Formula

Profit % = (Total Profit ÷ Total CP) × 100. In this case, Profit % = (9.8 ÷ 34.2) × 100 ≈ 28.65%.</p

questions.question: On certain sum, the simple interest for 2 years is Rs. 12000. If the sum is Rs. 12000, then what will be the compound interest (compounding annually) on the same sum at the same rate of interest for the first 3 years?
questions.solution:
Principal (P) = Rs. 12000

Simple interest (SI) for 2 years = Rs. 12000

Find compound interest (CI) for 3 years

Concept: Rate of interest can be calculated from SI, then applied to calculate CI.

Solution:

Rate of interest (r) = (SI × 100)/(P × t) = (12000 × 100)/(12000 × 2) = 50% per annum

CI for 3 years at 50% per annum = P[(1 + r/100)3 - 1] = 12000[(1 + 50/100)3 - 1]

CI = 12000[(3/2)3 - 1] = 12000[27/8 - 1] = Rs. 28500

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Interest = 12000 for 2 years

So 

Interest = 6000 for 1 year

Principal = Rs. 12000

Means Rate of Interest = 50%

So

Compound interest for 3 years:-

Compound interest for 2 years = 50 + 50 + 50 × 50/100 = 125%

Compound interest for 3 years = 125 + 50 + 125 × 50/100 = 237.5% of Principal

Compound interest = 237.5 × 12000/100 = 28500

Hence, the compound interest for the first 3 years is Rs. 28500

questions.question: A dealer gains 20% when he sells an article by giving 10% discount on its list price. If the cost price of the article is decreased by 40% and the dealer still wants to earn 30% profit, then how much discount (in percentage) should the dealer offer on the same list price?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let List Price (LP) = 100.

SP = 100 − 10% = 90 → CP = 90 ÷ 1.20 = 75.

New CP (decreased by 40%) = 75 × 0.60 = 45.

New SP (for 30% profit) = 45 × 1.30 = 58.5.

New Discount % on same LP = 100 − 58.5 = 41.5%.

**∴ The correct answer is 41.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial gain = 20%, Initial discount on LP = 10%

Cost price decreases by 40%

New desired profit = 30%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = List Price (LP) × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

Cost Price (CP) = SP × 100 ÷ (100 + Profit%)

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 CP = 75

 
 SP = 90

 
 LP = 100

 

 +20% Gain

 

 -10% Disc

 

 -40%

 
 New CP = 45

 
 New SP = 58.5

 
 LP = 100

 

 +30% Gain

 

 ? Discount
 41.5%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let List Price (LP) = 100

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = 100 − 10% of 100 = 90

⇒ Cost Price (CP) = 90 ÷ 1.2 = 75

⇒ New Cost Price = 75 − 40% of 75 = 75 − 30 = 45

⇒ New Selling Price = 45 + 30% of 45 = 45 + 13.5 = 58.5

⇒ Discount offered on same LP = 100 − 58.5 = 41.5

⇒ Required Discount % = (41.5 ÷ 100) × 100 = 41.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 41.5%.**

Marked Price and Cost Price Relation

questions.question: The number of factors of 588 is
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Prime factorize **588**: 588 = 2² × 3¹ × 7².

Apply the formula for **total factors**: (p + 1) × (q + 1) × (r + 1), where p, q, r are the powers.

Calculation: (2 + 1) × (1 + 1) × (2 + 1) = 3 × 2 × 3 = 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Number = 588

**Formula Used:** If a number N = pa × qb × rc, then the total number of factors = (a + 1)(b + 1)(c + 1).

⇒ 588 = 2 × 294

⇒ 588 = 2 × 2 × 147

⇒ 588 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 49

⇒ 588 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7 × 7

⇒ 588 = 2² × 3¹ × 7²

⇒ Total factors = (2 + 1) × (1 + 1) × (2 + 1)

⇒ Total factors = 3 × 2 × 3

⇒ Total factors = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

**__Additional Information__**

Sum of Factors

For N = pa × qb, the sum is [(pa⁺¹ − 1)/(p − 1)] × [(qb⁺¹ − 1)/(q − 1)].

Product of Factors

The product of all factors of a number N is given by N⁽Total Factors / ²⁾.

Distinct Prime Factors

These are the unique prime numbers that divide the given number. For 588, the distinct prime factors are 2, 3, and 7.</p

questions.question: The value of (0.23overline{54} + 0.24overline{46}) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expand the repeating decimals to a few terms and add them directly column by column.

First number = 0.23545454...

Second number = 0.24464646...

Sum = 0.23545454... + 0.24464646... = 0.48010101...

The digits '01' are repeating continuously, which is written as 0.4801.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.4801.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = 0.2354 + 0.2446

**Formula Used:**

To convert a mixed recurring decimal to a fraction:

Fraction = (Complete number − Non-recurring part) ÷ (Number of 9s equal to recurring digits followed by 0s equal to non-recurring digits)

**Calculations:**

⇒ 0.2354 = (2354 − 23) ÷ 9900 = 2331 ÷ 9900

⇒ 0.2446 = (2446 − 24) ÷ 9900 = 2422 ÷ 9900

⇒ Sum = (2331 ÷ 9900) + (2422 ÷ 9900)

⇒ Sum = (2331 + 2422) ÷ 9900

⇒ Sum = 4753 ÷ 9900

Now, to convert the fraction back to a recurring decimal, we structure the numerator in the form (Complete number − Non-recurring part):

⇒ 4753 ÷ 9900 = (4801 − 48) ÷ 9900

⇒ Therefore, the matching decimal format is 0.4801

**∴ The correct answer is 0.4801.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pure Recurring Decimal

A decimal in which all the digits after the decimal point are repeated continuously is called a pure recurring decimal. Example: 0.7 = 7 ÷ 9.

Mixed Recurring Decimal

A decimal in which at least one digit after the decimal point is not repeated and then some digits are repeated is called a mixed recurring decimal. Example: 0.16 = (16 − 1) ÷ 90 = 15 ÷ 90 = 1 ÷ 6.

Fraction Rules

When adding fractions with the exact same denominator, directly add the numerators while keeping the denominator identical.

questions.question: The ratio of the sides of a triangles is 11 ∶ 11 ∶ 4. If the area of triangle is 2sqrt{117} cm², then what is the length of the equal sides?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Let the common ratio multiplier be x, making the sides of the triangle 11x, 11x, and 4x.

Drawing a perpendicular to the base bisects it, forming right-angled triangles with hypotenuse 11x and base 2x.

Height = √((11x)² − (2x)²) = √(121x² − 4x²) = √(117x²) = x√117.

Area = ½ × Base × Height = ½ × 4x × x√117 = 2x²√117.

Given Area = 2√117 cm² ⇒ 2x²√117 = 2√117 ⇒ x² = 1 ⇒ x = 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of sides = 11 : 11 : 4

Area of triangle = 2√117 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Heron's Formula: Area = √(s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c))

Semi-perimeter, s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

• 
ABCD11x11x2x2xh = x√117
• 
• 
• Base = 4x
**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the sides of the triangle be a = 11x, b = 11x, and c = 4x.

⇒ Semi-perimeter, s = (11x + 11x + 4x) ÷ 2 = 26x ÷ 2 = 13x.

⇒ Applying Heron's Formula for area:

⇒ Area = √(13x × (13x − 11x) × (13x − 11x) × (13x − 4x))

⇒ Area = √(13x × 2x × 2x × 9x)

⇒ Area = √(468x⁴) = √(4 × 117 × x⁴) = 2x²√117

⇒ Equating this with the given area:

⇒ 2x²√117 = 2√117

⇒ x² = 1

⇒ x = 1 cm

⇒ Length of the equal sides = 11x = 11 × 1 = 11 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Isosceles Triangle Height

In an isosceles triangle, the altitude drawn to the unequal side (base) bisects both the base and the vertex angle, dividing the triangle into two congruent right-angled triangles.

Heron's Formula

Heron's formula computes the area of any triangle directly from its three side lengths: Area = √(s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)), where s is the semi-perimeter.

Direct Area Formula for Isosceles Triangle

An isosceles triangle with equal sides a and base b has the direct area formula: Area = (b ÷ 4)√(4a² − b²).

questions.question: P got married 15 years ago. Today her age is 1(3)/(5) times her age at the time of her marriage. At present her son's age is (1)/(5) of her age. What was her son's age 4 years ago as a fraction of P's age at that time?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of P's present age to age at marriage = 1(3/5) = 8 : 5.

Difference of 3 parts = 15 years ⇒ 1 part = 5 years.

P's present age = 8 × 5 = 40 years.

Son's present age = 40 × (1/5) = 8 years.

4 years ago, Son = 4 years and P = 36 years. Required fraction = 4 / 36 = 1/9.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P's present age = 1(3/5) × (P's age 15 years ago) = 8/5 × (P's age 15 years ago)

Son's present age = 1/5 × (P's present age)

 Age Timeline
 
 
 Present Age
 P = 40 yrs
 Son = 8 yrs

 
 4 Years Ago
 P = 36 yrs
 Son = 4 yrs

 
 
 

 
 
 
• 
 − 4 years
 
 
 Ratio = 4 / 36 = 1 / 9

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let P's present age be x.

⇒ Age of P 15 years ago = x − 15

⇒ x = (8/5) × (x − 15)

⇒ 5x = 8x − 120

⇒ 3x = 120

⇒ x = 40 years

⇒ P's present age = 40 years.

⇒ Present age of son = (1/5) × 40 = 8 years.

⇒ 4 years ago, P's age = 40 − 4 = 36 years.

⇒ 4 years ago, Son's age = 8 − 4 = 4 years.

⇒ Required fraction = 4 / 36 = 1 / 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio of Ages

If the ratio of ages of two persons is a:b, their ages can be represented as ax and bx. The age difference between two persons always remains constant over time.

Fractional Relationships

A relationship given as 1(3/5) times means a multiplying factor of 8/5. Expressing conditions as fractions directly yields a simple linear equation.

Problems on Ages

It is highly recommended to always calculate the present ages first. This establishes a fixed reference point before finding any past or future ages.

questions.question: The population of a variety of plants in a research increased by 5% in the first month, increased by 7.5% in the second month but decreased by 10% in the third month. If the present number of plants in research is 8127, then the number of plants in the beginning was:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Present number of plants = 8127

Increased by 5% in the first month, increased by 7.5% in the second month and decreased by 10% in the third month.

**Formula used:**

If the present population of a city is P and there is a increment or decrement of R1%, R2%, and R3% in first, second and third year respectively then population of city after 3 years will be = P(1 ± dfrac{R1}{100})(1 ± dfrac{R2}{100})(1 ± dfrac{R3}{100})

**Calculations:**

Let the number be 100x.

Firstly, increased by 5% = 100x + 100x × 5%

= 100x + 100x × dfrac{5}{100}

=100x + 5x = 105x

Secondly, increased by 7.5% = 100x + 100x × 7.5%

= 100x + 100x × dfrac{7.5}{100}

= 100x + 7.5x = 107.5x

Thirdly, decreased by 10% = 100x - 100x × 7.5%

= 100x - 100x × dfrac{10}{100}

= 100x - 10x = 90x

Now, the number of plants in the starting was = 8127 × dfrac{100}{105} × dfrac{100}{107.5} × dfrac{100}{90} = 8000.

**∴ The answer is 8000.**

questions.question: The HCF of two numbers is one-twentieth of their LCM. If one of the numbers is 96 and the difference of the LCM and the HCF is 456, then what is the other number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let HCF = 1 unit and LCM = 20 units.

Difference between LCM and HCF = 20 − 1 = 19 units.

Given 19 units = 456 ⇒ 1 unit (HCF) = 24.

LCM = 20 × 24 = 480.

Other Number = (HCF × LCM) ÷ First Number = (24 × 480) ÷ 96 = 120.

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number (n₁) = 96

HCF = LCM ÷ 20

LCM − HCF = 456

**Formula Used:**

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2df10b69cfc840a9c0ccfad4073681e2cdb281fef1269ce04e706b53af84b3d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let LCM = L and HCF = H.

⇒ H = L ÷ 20 ⇒ L = 20H.

⇒ L − H = 456

⇒ 20H − H = 456

⇒ 19H = 456

⇒ H = 456 ÷ 19 = 24.

⇒ L = 20 × 24 = 480.

⇒ Let the other number be n₂.

⇒ n₁ × n₂ = H × L

⇒ 96 × n₂ = 24 × 480

⇒ n₂ = (24 × 480) ÷ 96

⇒ n₂ = 480 ÷ 4 = 120.

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product Rule

For any two numbers a and b, the relationship is always: a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b).

Divisibility Property

The HCF of any set of numbers is always a factor of their LCM.

Co-prime Numbers

If two numbers are co-prime, their HCF is 1 and their LCM is equal to their product.</p
